notes: Quarterly issuer tender by a non-listed BDC under its share repurchase program. size_shares is stated as an estimate ('up to an estimated 390,941'): the cap is the number of Shares 90% of the DRIP proceeds from the April 1, 2021 dividend can buy, so the count depends on the Purchase Price; the 390,941 figure uses the December 31, 2020 NAV of $7.28 as an example. size_pct_outstanding is null: 390,941 of 80,099,885 Shares outstanding (April 12, 2021) would need arithmetic, and the programme's 2.5%-per-quarter of weighted-average shares is a programme cap, not this offer's size. price_pct_nav=100 because the price is stated as 'equal to the net asset value per Share', not as a percent. The shareholder letter (seq 5) also says the program repurchases 'at a price equal to the net asset value per Share, as determined within 48 hours prior to the date we repurchase Shares'; the offer documents fix the NAV date as May 31, 2021 (after the May 17, 2021 expiration). Commencement taken from the Offer to Purchase date (April 12, 2021). Conditions also include violation of law, credit/currency limitations and war or calamity (read as market_disruption); the offer is not conditioned on any minimum number of Shares. Odd-lot priority applies under proration. No ticker: the Shares are not listed.
